pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

This is a followup to https://github.com/tikv/client-go/pull/421 to remove old `etcd` dependency from the codebase and ease the use of all libraries based on this repository.

This remove completely `go.etcd.io/etcd v0.5.0-alpha.5.0.20210512015243-d19fbe541bf9` from dependency to replace with `v3` APIs.

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/32241

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

Mostly changed all imports to new V3 API namespace from `etcd`

### Check List

Tests have been updated.

- [X] Unit test
- [X] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

Side effects

Honestly I don't really know for this part, I would argue that's probably the same, or better than old `etcd` dependency.

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- bugfix or new feature needs a release note -->

```release-note
None
```
